Game Overview

In Monster Hospital, the core idea is straightforward: heal spooky creatures in Monster Hospital as you tackle thrilling mini-games to fix their ailments. Race against time, learn, and have fun while honing your doctoring skills. This accessible and engaging experience lets kids explore the world of medicine in a monster-filled adventure.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Monster Hospital is easy to pick up. Heal spooky creatures in Monster Hospital as you tackle thrilling mini-games to fix their ailments.
